reason: S1 adds the new public API sarrayConcatUniformly, but H0 only decodes SPIX data with pixReadMemSpix and invokes PIX image-enhancement functions. H0 cannot call the new entry point or control its SARRAY contents, output-count parameter n, or addnlflag. This gap did not exist for sarrayConcatUniformly in S0 because the function and its declaration were introduced by this commit.
evidence: src/allheaders.h adds the exported declaration for sarrayConcatUniformly(SARRAY *sa, l_int32 n, l_int32 addnlflag).
src/sarray1.c adds the complete sarrayConcatUniformly implementation, including branches for null sa, n < 1, n > ntot, and invalid addnlflag values.
The new implementation processes string-array structure and calls numaGetUniformBinSizes, sarrayToStringRange, and sarrayAddString.
H0 creates its sole fuzz-derived object through pixReadMemSpix(data, size) and exercises PIX-oriented functions; it never creates an SARRAY or calls sarrayConcatUniformly.
The string_reg.c addition demonstrates the new API with sarrayCreateLinesFromString and parameters n = 6 and addnlflag = 0, inputs that H0 cannot supply.
recommended_action: Add or extend a fuzz harness to construct fuzz-controlled SARRAY contents and invoke sarrayConcatUniformly with fuzz-controlled n and addnlflag, including valid and invalid parameter combinations.
